overloads.semanticRole: The WP COMPUTE FORMULAS command evaluates the formulas in targetObj .

constraints: targetObj can be a range, an element (table/row/cell(s)/paragraph/body/header/footer/section/subsection/inline or anchored picture/text box), or a whole 4D Write Pro document.

When targetObj is a section, only image formulas or formulas in text boxes anchored to that section (or to all sections) are computed; formulas anchored to a page or to the embedded view are not computed unless targetObj is the whole document.
